full_name: National Eye Institute 25-item Visual Function Questionnaire
domains: 11 vision-related constructs plus a single general-health item (p2)
scoring: composite score = average of the 11 vision-related subscale scores; general health item excluded (p2)
notes: paper cites prior reliability and validity (refs 17, 18) but reports no new validation; here the composite predicts PQoL poorly (r 0.276; R2 change 0.050)

full_name: Single-item global measure of quality of life (PQoL)
response_scale: 5-point (excellent, very good, good, fair, poor) weighted 0, 25, 50, 75, 100 (p2)
notes: item: In the past 6 months, I would say my overall QoL has been excellent, very good, good, fair, or poor (p2)
